name: Freezing Floor Tiles

stealth.note: +23 (expert) or @Check[perception|dc:38|traits:action:seek] (master) to notice the four sensors

description: Four remote sensors at each corner of the arena cause bursts of freezing magic to erupt from random tiles on the arena and stop creatures in their tracks.
disable: DC 40 Thievery (legendary) or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 38) to disable one of the sensors
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action per disabled sensor. On each action, the trap causes a random 10-foot-by-10-foot space in the arena to suddenly freeze. Each creature that begins its turn in a frozen space takes (2d6+2) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that critically fails its save also becomes Slowed 1 for 1 round; if it was already slowed, the creature instead becomes Immobilized for 1 round. Any amount of fire damage dealt to a slowed or immobilized creature removes the condition. Frozen tiles become unfrozen at the beginning of the trap's next turn.
